title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Sourcer — India
description:
Part\-Time Talent Sourcer / Recruiter — IndiaMarketing, Development \& AI Talent Screening

We are a New Zealand\-based business building and growing multiple ventures, including Viewings.co.nz, a property technology platform for the New Zealand market.

We are looking for a sharp, organised, and practical Talent Sourcer / Recruiter in India who can help us find, speak with, screen, and shortlist quality candidates and offshore partners.

This is a part\-time / freelance role to start, with the potential to grow if the results are strong.

Important: This Is Not a CV Forwarding Role

We are not looking for someone who simply collects resumes and forwards them to us.

Your job is to properly screen candidates before they reach us.

You must speak with candidates, understand their skills, assess their personality, check their communication, review their past work where possible, and only shortlist people who are genuinely worth our time.

The goal is quality, not quantity.

What You Will Help Us Find

You will help us source and shortlist people for roles such as:

* B2B marketing interns
* Junior digital marketing executives
* SEO and content marketing people
* Email marketing and LinkedIn outreach specialists
* Lead generation executives
* Full\-stack developers
* AI / automation talent
* CRM and business process automation people
* Offshore development companies
* Remote technical teams and freelancers
* Other business support roles as needed

Key Requirement

You must have a good practical understanding of marketing, development, and AI.

You do not need to be a senior marketer, developer, or AI engineer yourself, but you must understand these areas well enough to screen candidates properly, ask sensible questions, identify weak candidates, and shortlist people who can actually do the work.

You should be able to understand the difference between someone who talks well and someone who can actually deliver.

Main Responsibilities

* Source candidates from LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, communities, referrals, WhatsApp groups, and other channels
* Speak directly with candidates before recommending them
* Conduct initial screening calls
* Check communication skills, attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn
* Understand salary expectations and availability
* Confirm whether candidates can work with New Zealand time zones when required
* Review examples of past work, portfolios, GitHub, LinkedIn profiles, case studies, or campaign examples where relevant
* Ask basic role\-specific questions for marketing, development, AI, CRM, and automation roles
* Identify whether the candidate fits a fast\-moving startup environment
* Maintain a clean candidate tracker with notes and status
* Coordinate interviews with our team
* Follow up with candidates professionally
* Help compare freelancers, interns, full\-time staff, and offshore development companies

Screening Expectations

Before forwarding any candidate to us, you should provide:

* Candidate name and contact details
* Role they are suitable for
* Current location
* Experience summary
* Salary expectation
* Availability/notice period
* English communication level
* Strengths
* Weaknesses or concerns
* Past work reviewed, if any
* Your recommendation
* Why you believe this person is worth interviewing

Where suitable, we would also like you to use simple assessment methods such as:

* basic personality\-fit questions
* communication checks
* problem\-solving questions
* practical task\-based screening
* light psychometric\-style screening, if you are experienced with it

We do not need complicated testing. We need practical, intelligent filtering.

What We Are Looking For

You must be:

* Very diligent and organised
* Good at written and spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with candidates
* Good at using LinkedIn, Indeed, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, and AI tools
* Able to follow instructions properly
* Fast, practical, and reliable
* Comfortable working with a New Zealand\-based business
* Able to source both individuals and companies
* Able to judge attitude, communication, and execution ability
* Honest about candidate quality

Who This Role Suits

This role is suitable for someone who has experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, HR, staffing, or freelance hiring, especially for marketing, tech, startup, or remote roles.

You may be an independent recruiter, freelance recruiter, HR professional, or talent sourcer looking for part\-time work with an international business.

Expected Weekly Output

Each week, we expect clear progress, including:

* Candidates sourced
* Candidates spoken to
* Candidates rejected and why
* Candidates shortlisted and why
* Screening notes
* Salary expectations
* Availability
* Recommended next steps
* Offshore companies or freelancers reviewed, where relevant

How to Apply

Please apply with:

* Your recruitment or talent sourcing experience
* Types of roles you have hired or shortlisted for
* Your experience with marketing, development, AI, or remote hiring
* Your expected monthly or hourly rate
* How soon you can start
* Your availability each week
* A sample candidate tracker or shortlist format, if available

Please also answer this question:

If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property technology startup, what steps would you take in the first 7 days?

Pay: ₹9,348\.75 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Before sending a candidate to us, how would you check if they have the right skills, attitude, communication, salary expectations, availability, and startup fit? Please explain your screening process.
* Tell us about one candidate you rejected even though their CV looked good. Why did you reject them, and what did you learn from that?
* If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property\-tech startup, what exact steps would you take in the first 7 days?

title: Store Assistant
description:
The Store Assistant is responsible for managing the receipt, storage, issuance, and inventory of all materials required for cinema operations, including F\&B items, housekeeping supplies, maintenance materials, and stationery. The role ensures accurate stock control and timely availability of materials while maintaining proper documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Receive and verify incoming materials against purchase orders and delivery challans.
* Inspect the quantity and quality of received items.
* Arrange and store materials systematically to ensure easy identification and retrieval.
* Issue materials to departments based on approved requisition slips.
* Maintain stock registers and update inventory records accurately.
* Monitor stock levels and report low\-stock items to the Store In\-Charge or Manager.
* Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly stock verification.
* Maintain FIFO (First In, First Out) and FEFO (First Expiry, First Out) practices where applicable.
* Ensure proper storage conditions for food items and other materials.
* Coordinate with the Purchase Department for material requirements.
* Prepare Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), stock reports, and issue records.
* Keep the store clean, organized, and compliant with safety standards.
* Assist during monthly inventory audits and stock reconciliation.
* Minimize wastage, damage, and pilferage of materials.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of inventory management and stock handling.
* Basic computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word, and inventory software).
* Good organizational and record\-keeping skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Basic understanding of store documentation and reporting.

Qualification

* Any Bachelor's Degree or Diploma.
* Experience in Cinema, Retail, Hospitality, Restaurant, or Hotel industry is preferred.

Experience

* **2–5 years** of experience as a Store Assistant or Store Executive.
* Experience in handling F\&B inventory will be an added advantage.

Working Hours

* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

Preferred Candidate

* Physically fit to handle loading, unloading, and movement of store materials.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
The HR Recruiter is responsible for attracting, sourcing, screening, and hiring qualified candidates to meet the organization's staffing needs. The role involves managing the full recruitment cycle, collaborating with hiring managers, and ensuring a positive candidate experience while maintaining compliance with company policies and employment regulations.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract top talent.
* Create and post job advertisements on job boards, social media, and company career portals.
* Source candidates through various channels, including databases, referrals, networking, and professional platforms.
* Screen resumes and applications to identify suitable candidates.
* Conduct phone, virtual, and in\-person interviews.
* Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring managers.
* Perform reference checks and background verification as required.
* Prepare and extend job offers to selected candidates.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for future hiring needs.
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, company policies, and diversity hiring initiatives.
* Participate in employer branding and recruitment events such as job fairs and campus drives.
* Generate recruitment reports and provide hiring updates to management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR operations.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes, interview techniques, and employment regulations.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms.

Skills and Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.
* Organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR software.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Attention to detail and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

* HR certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR) is an advantage.
* Experience recruiting across multiple departments and job levels.
* Knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Time\-to\-fill positions.
* Quality of hires.
* Candidate satisfaction.
* Offer acceptance rate.
* Recruitment cost per hire.
* Hiring manager satisfaction.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

description:
**Job description**

As the Teacher Trainer you would be responsible for building the capacity of Instruction Specialists/ ICT Teachers and facilitating Labs at partner government and affordable private schools to create a high\-quality computer science education ecosystem for student learning. This would include exhibiting excellent training skills, teaching, a well\-balanced, analytical and creative mindset to problem\-solve and provide innovative solutions, along with taking the initiative to own and build a part of reflective of their own core values that concur with the organizational vision and genuinely commits themselves to ensure that the value our program adds to a student’s life is sustainable, meaningful and greater than individual motivations.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**  
● Trainings and Capacity Building  
○ Builds teachers’ capacity through conducting various training sessions as per the program and on the job assistance during monitoring visits so that they best meet their teaching\-learning and school management responsibilities  
○ Collect, devise and share with schools, successful teaching methodologies that can be implemented in the classroom.  
○ Undertakes teachers’ training needs assessment, prepares training plans, develops training aid materials and conducts evaluation of training sessions  
○ Assists Program, Curriculum Development and Research team in developing training manuals.  
○ Participates in professional growth and development and stays abreast of current research through continuing education, educational seminars,workshops,conferences, membership in profession  
○ Participate in sessions during the beginning of the year training programme as per the schedule shared by the organisation.  
○ Participate in the monthly learning circles to share best practices with other teachersand prepare for the upcoming classes  
○ Work with the Program Manager to build teaching capacity as per their feedback

● Program Delivery  
○ Collects and compiles school and training data and assists the Program team in data analysis and interpretation and report development.  
○ Submits accurate and proper monitoring, supervision, training, observation, and other relevant reports to the Program Team in timely manner  
○ Support Program team in order to enhance the quality of basic education.  
○ Ensure Optimum instructional delivery of Curriculum across the specified grades in assigned school(s). This may involve teaching(\& travel) in classrooms spread across the city.  
○ Creation of monthly grade specific goals and daily lesson plans with the help of Program Manager in curriculum and teaching philosophy.  
○ Assess and Monitor Student Learning Outcomes and accomplishments in a variety of ways(Assessments, Projects, Quiz, etc) on a regular basis and provide progress  
reports as required  
● Event  
○ Coordinate with school authorities / teachers and support them to conduct an annual showcase for the students in your school.  
○ Conduct hackathons, quizzes, field visits for students to increase interest and provide learning experiences.  
○ Support Team in basic operational and program/event requirements for the annual event(s).

title: Head Of Compensation & Benefits
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you.

 **Job Description**  

Version 1 is seeking a Head of Compensation \& Benefits to lead the design, implementation, and management of our global total reward strategy. As the business continues to scale across multiple regions, this role will ensure our compensation and benefits programmes are competitive, fair, and aligned with our growth objectives.


You will take ownership of pay structures, job evaluation frameworks, benefits provision, and reward programmes across all Version 1 locations. Working closely with senior leadership, Finance, and People teams, you will use market data and internal analytics to shape reward decisions that attract, retain, and motivate talent globally.


This is a strategic and hands\-on role, suited to someone who combines deep technical expertise in compensation and benefits with strong commercial awareness and the ability to operate across multiple jurisdictions.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of Version 1’s global compensation and benefits strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market competitiveness.
* Manage and develop the Compensation \& Benefits team, setting clear goals, reviewing outputs, and supporting professional growth.
* Design and maintain job evaluation and grading frameworks to ensure internal equity and consistency across all regions.
* Conduct regular market benchmarking and salary surveys to inform pay positioning and ensure competitiveness in key talent markets including India, UK, and Ireland.
* Own the annual pay review and bonus cycle end to end, partnering with Finance and senior leadership on budgeting, modelling, and communications.
* Design, implement, and manage employee benefits programmes across all operating regions, ensuring they meet local requirements and employee needs.
* Develop and maintain total reward statements and communications that help employees understand the full value of their package.
* Provide data\-driven insights and reporting on compensation and benefits spend, trends, and effectiveness to senior leadership.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant employment legislation, tax regulations, and reporting requirements relating to pay and benefits across all jurisdictions.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop competitive offer frameworks and support hiring decisions with market data.
* Support M\&A activity by conducting compensation and benefits due diligence and leading the harmonisation of reward programmes for acquired entities.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and tools, including increased use of technology and automation in reward administration.
* Manage relationships with external benefits providers, brokers, and consultants, ensuring value for money and quality of service.
* Contribute to broader People team strategy, bringing a reward and total compensation perspective to strategic discussions.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Compensation \& Benefits (e.g. GRP, CCP, CIPD) is desirable.
* 8\+ years of experience in compensation and benefits, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role.
* Proven track record of designing and managing compensation and benefits programmes across multiple countries.
* Strong knowledge of job evaluation methodologies (e.g. Willis Towers Watson, Mercer, Hay).
* Deep understanding of employment legislation, tax, and regulatory requirements relating to pay and benefits across India, UK, and Ireland.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in compensation modelling, benchmarking, and data analysis.
* Experience with HRIS and compensation management platforms (knowledge of Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar would be an advantage).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex reward data clearly to senior leadership.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance employee value with business affordability.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a creative, curious, and slightly obsessive\-about\-social\-media intern to join our team and get real, hands\-on exposure to running social media for both RevX Hospitality and our client accounts. You'll actually help plan content, track what's working, connect with influencers, and see how a brand's online presence is built one post at a time. * Support outreach to identify, connect, and coordinate with relevant influencers and content creators for collaborations — from first message to content approval and posting.

* Support in preparing monthly and campaign\-wise performance reports with simple insights.
* Learn to use scheduling and analytics tools like Buffer, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite, or Sprout Social.

* Make sure everything posted follows brand guidelines and client expectations.

**What We're Looking For**

* Some familiarity with Canva; bonus points for Adobe Creative Suite or CapCut.

* Comfortable with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

* Strong understanding of social media analytics, reporting tools, and performance measurement.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social campaigns, SEO, and content marketing principles.
* Experience in influencer marketing, campaign management, and partnership coordination

**Who you are:**

* Genuinely into social media — you notice trends before your friends do.
* A clear, confident communicator, both written and verbal.
* Creative with a good sense of storytelling and content ideas.
* Detail\-oriented with a bit of an analytical streak — numbers interest you as much as visuals.
* Comfortable juggling multiple accounts and deadlines at once.
* Client\-friendly and easy to work with across teams.
* Self\-motivated and adaptable — social media never really has a "quiet day."

**About RevX Hospitality**

RevX Hospitality helps hotels unlock their full revenue potential. We combine data\-driven strategy with hands\-on industry expertise to optimise pricing, boost profitability, and improve operational efficiency for our hotel partners. It's a fast\-paced, growth\-focused environment — and social media plays a big role in how we tell that story, both for ourselves and for our clients.

title: SOP Writer
description:
Career Opportunity: CONTRACTUAL ENGAGEMENT OF SOP WRITER

(Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive)

About Pradhan Industries

Pradhan Industries is a well\-established organization engaged in Natural Graphite Mining, Mineral Processing and Graphite Beneficiation in Odisha. With multiple mining leases, beneficiation plants and expansion projects, the Company is continuously working towards operational excellence, process standardization, industrial modernization and sustainable growth.

Our operations involve mining, crushing, grinding, flotation, drying, pulverising, packaging, dispatch and allied industrial activities supported by mechanical, electrical, stores, procurement, logistics and statutory compliance functions.

To strengthen our management systems and establish standardized operating practices across all our units, we invite applications from highly experienced professionals for the position of SOP Writer (Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive) on a contractual basis.

Position Details

Designation: SOP Writer (Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive)

Nature of Engagement: Contractual

Contract Duration: Initially 11 Months (Extendable based on performance and Company requirement)

Location: Corporate Office, Bhubaneswar

Travel Requirement: Frequent visits to Company mines, beneficiation plants and project sites in Odisha.

Job Objective

The selected candidate shall be responsible for studying the Company’s existing operations, interacting with various departments, understanding actual field practices and preparing comprehensive, practical and implementable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Standard Work Instructions (SWIs), Manuals, Checklists, Process Documents, Formats and Operational Guidelines.

The SOPs should standardize operations, improve efficiency, strengthen safety, reduce operational variations and establish uniform working practices across the organization.

Scope of SOP Preparation

The candidate shall independently prepare SOPs and related documentation for, but not limited to, the following departments and activities:

* Production
* Process / Beneficiation Operations
* Electrical Maintenance
* Mechanical Maintenance
* Stores \& Inventory Management
* Procurement \& Supply
* Material Handling \& Internal Movement
* Packaging
* Stacking
* Loading \& Dispatch
* Mining Operations \& Allied Activities
* Industrial Statutory Compliance
* Mining Statutory Compliance

The Management may assign additional departments and functions as required.

Key Responsibilities

* Study existing work practices and operational procedures.
* Visit mines, plants and project sites to understand actual field operations.
* Interact with department heads, engineers, supervisors, operators and workmen.
* Analyse complete workflows and identify opportunities for process standardization.
* Prepare comprehensive SOPs, SWIs, Manuals, Checklists, Process Flow Charts, Forms and Documentation.
* Develop department\-wise operational manuals and process documents.
* Prepare workflow diagrams, responsibility matrices and documentation templates.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance productivity, quality, safety and operational efficiency.
* Ensure all SOPs are practical, easy to understand and implementable.
* Review, update and revise SOPs whenever operational changes occur.
* Maintain proper document control, revision history and version management.
* Submit periodic progress reports to the Management.

Essential Eligibility Criteria

This position is not intended for freshers or candidates having only documentation experience.

The Company is specifically looking for a highly experienced industrial professional having practical exposure to manufacturing, mining or process industries and capable of independently understanding plant operations and converting them into standardized operating procedures.

Experience

* Minimum 8–15 years of relevant industrial experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, mining, mineral processing, beneficiation plants, heavy engineering or similar process industries shall be preferred.
* Prior experience in developing SOPs, operational manuals, ISO documentation, technical documentation or process standardization will be an added advantage.

Essential Technical Knowledge

The candidate must possess sound practical knowledge of:

* Industrial Plant Operations
* Production Systems
* Mineral Processing \& Beneficiation
* Mining Operations
* Mechanical Maintenance
* Electrical Maintenance
* Preventive, Predictive and Breakdown Maintenance
* Industrial Machinery and Equipment
* Crushers
* Conveyors
* Ball Mills and Grinding Systems
* Pumps
* Motors
* Gearboxes
* Bearings
* Dryers
* Pulverisers
* Material Handling Systems
* Workshop Practices
* Utilities
* Plant Safety
* Stores \& Inventory Management
* Procurement \& Supply Chain
* Packaging, Stacking, Loading \& Dispatch Operations
* Industrial Documentation
* Industrial Statutory Compliance
* Mining Statutory Compliance
* Process Improvement and Continuous Improvement Methodologies

Educational Qualification

Candidates possessing one or more of the following qualifications may apply:

* B.E. / B.Tech.
* Diploma in Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Mining Engineering
* Mineral Processing Engineering
* Production Engineering
* Any other relevant technical qualification with substantial industrial experience.

Desired Skills

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Strong command over written English.
* Practical industrial knowledge.
* Strong analytical and observation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex industrial processes into structured documents.
* Excellent communication and interviewing skills.
* Strong coordination abilities.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prepare professional reports, manuals, forms and documentation.

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* Mining
* Mineral Beneficiation
* Graphite
* Iron Ore
* Coal
* Cement
* Steel
* Power Plants
* Heavy Engineering
* EPC Projects
* Manufacturing Industries
* Process Industries

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate shall be expected to:

* Complete assigned SOPs within the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure accuracy, practicality and completeness of all documentation.
* Standardize processes across departments.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all Company information.
* Work closely with the Management and departmental teams to achieve documentation objectives.

Remuneration

Consolidated monthly remuneration shall be commensurate with the candidate’s qualification, industrial experience, competency and overall suitability for the role.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated Resume to **7338405666**

Only shortlisted candidates shall be contacted for the selection process.

Pradhan Industries

Join us in building standardized, efficient and world\-class industrial systems through practical documentation, process excellence and operational discipline.

* You will Independently perform and applies skills to resolve sophisticated problems not covered by existing procedures or practices.

* High ownership mindset with a bias for action and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
* Tech\-savvy, adaptable, and proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO / Operations Support Coordinator - Mumbai, India
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------


DentistFind is a leading marketing technology company based in Canada, with 15 years of expertise in empowering dental practices across the globe. Our mission is to facilitate seamless and sustainable growth for dental practices through our innovative PracticeFuel platform, which leverages data\-driven digital marketing strategies and cutting\-edge technology solutions. By focusing on increasing patient acquisition and retention, DentistFind provides a stable and prestigious work environment that offers opportunities for growth and international exposure.
Our comprehensive approach combines advanced technology with personalized consultation, equipping dental professionals with the tools and guidance necessary to achieve their goals. The intuitive platform delivers real\-time notifications, actionable reports, and performance reviews, while our expert consultants offer tailored training and support. This focus on ease of use and collaboration allows dental practices to concentrate on delivering exceptional patient care, ensuring steady growth and success in the ever\-evolving dental industry.**Why Join DentistFind?**
-------------------------


At DentistFind, we believe in clarity over complexity, extreme ownership, and building systems that scale. As a rapidly growing dental marketing and technology partner, we empower dental practices with data\-driven strategies, cutting\-edge tools, and a relentless focus on measurable outcomes. Join us to be a part of a team that values innovation, efficiency, and client success.**Job Overview**
----------------


DentistFind is seeking a high\-caliber **Executive Assistant to the CEO / Operations Support Coordinator** to act as the CEO’s cognitive filter and execution engine. This role sits at the center of the business, turning messy conversations, scattered information, and raw meeting notes into clear decisions, structured plans, and reliable follow\-through across Sales, Marketing, HR, Client Success, and Operations. You will reduce CEO drag, improve meeting quality, coordinate cross\-functional work, and maintain the operating systems that keep the company moving quickly and intelligently. This is a fast\-paced, remote role for someone who thinks in systems, thrives on challenge, and wants to help build performance and sales machines for a growing, technology\-driven dental marketing company.
### **Key Responsibilities**

* **CEO Support \& Information Filtering:** Review and refine documents, reports, and updates before they reach the CEO to ensure they answer the original business question, include supporting data, and have clear owners and deadlines; send back low\-quality or incomplete work with specific, respectful feedback.
* **Meeting Preparation \& Pre\-Reads:** Prepare structured agendas and collect updates prior to leadership and project meetings; create concise pre\-reads that highlight key metrics, issues, and decisions required from the CEO and stakeholders.
* **Meeting Notes \& Action Tracking:** Take clear, structured notes during meetings, capturing decisions, owners, deadlines, and blockers; convert discussions into action items in project tools, follow\-up messages, and updated trackers.
* **Operating Systems \& Trackers:** Build, maintain, and improve operating systems such as CEO Review Trackers, meeting trackers, task and project trackers, performance/experiment logs, and sales/partner tracking sheets to ensure visibility and accountability.
* **SOPs \& Process Documentation:** Create, refine, and standardize SOPs, checklists, templates, and process documents for recurring workflows (e.g., onboarding, performance reviews, campaign launches, reporting cadences).
* **Performance System Support:** Support the design and maintenance of a performance system that logs tests and experiments, tracks results, documents debriefs, and standardizes winning approaches across clients.
* **Sales System Support:** Help structure and maintain a simple, visible sales system and partner pipeline by tracking leads, partner activities, stages, and outcomes, ensuring the CEO and team have clear visibility on revenue motion.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate follow\-ups, dependencies, and deliverables across Marketing, Development, Client Success, HR, and Operations to make sure work escalated to the CEO is complete, structured, and decision\-ready.
* **Analytics \& Executive Summaries:** Synthesize data, transcripts, and multi\-source information into concise executive summaries and decision briefs that allow the CEO to act quickly with clear context, options, and implications.
* **AI\-Enabled Workflows:** Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) to summarize long documents and meeting transcripts, draft SOPs and templates, structure messy information, and improve the clarity and quality of written communication.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other ad hoc tasks and special projects as assigned by the Manager or CEO.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Communications, Marketing, or a related field (required).
* **Professional Experience:** Minimum 5 years of experience in roles such as Executive Assistant to CEO/Founder/Senior Executive, Operations Coordinator/Online Business Manager, or Project Manager/Junior Chief of Staff in a service, tech, or marketing environment (required).
* **Remote Operations Experience:** Proven experience working in remote, distributed teams and collaborating across multiple time zones and cultures (required).
* **Executive Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; demonstrated ability to produce CEO\-ready briefs, structured meeting notes, and clear, actionable follow\-up messages (required).
* **Critical Thinking \& Judgment:** Strong ability to understand business objectives behind tasks, separate facts from assumptions, identify missing information, and challenge vague or low\-quality inputs constructively (required).
* **Organization \& Follow\-Through:** Highly organized, self\-motivated, and proactive; proven track record of managing multiple streams of work, tracking owners and deadlines, and consistently closing loops until completion (required).
* **Systems \& Process Orientation:** Ability to build, document, and maintain trackers, SOPs, checklists, and basic operating systems that improve clarity, speed, and accountability (required).
* **Tools \& Technology:** Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Drive) and at least one project management tool (e.g., Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Airtable); comfortable using meeting transcription tools and AI tools like ChatGPT for summarization and documentation (required).
* **Values Alignment:** Demonstrated commitment to analytical decision making, speed and agility, strategic/performance focus, continuous improvement, integrity, transparency, and thriving in challenging, fast\-paced environments (required).
* **Discretion \& Professionalism:** Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism (required).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Experience:** Experience in marketing agencies, SaaS/technology businesses, healthcare, or dental\-related companies (preferred).
* **Founder/CEO Support:** Prior experience supporting a fast\-moving founder or CEO in a growth\-stage or entrepreneurial environment (preferred).
* **Sales/Client Service Context:** Exposure to recurring services, retainers, or subscription\-style businesses serving small or medium\-sized clients, especially in North America (preferred).
* **Process \& Playbook Development:** Experience creating SOPs, checklists, playbooks, or operating rhythms (e.g., weekly reviews, scorecards, meeting cadences) that improved team execution (preferred).
* **Data \& Reporting:** Comfort working with basic dashboards, reports, and performance metrics; experience helping to design or maintain simple reporting systems (preferred).
* **CRM \& Pipeline Familiarity**: Familiarity with CRM tools and basic pipeline tracking for leads, partners, or accounts (preferred).
* **Remote \& Cross\-Cultural Collaboration:** Strong history of working effectively with international remote teams (e.g., Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, India, etc.) and adapting communication style across cultures (preferred).
* **Project/Process Certifications**: Additional training or certifications in project management, operations, or process improvement (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean, Six Sigma) (preferred).
* **Transcript \& Content Synthesis:** Demonstrated ability to convert long\-form content—such as meeting transcripts, discovery calls, or strategy sessions—into concise, action\-oriented executive briefs (preferred).

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


The ideal candidate is a hybrid of an Executive Assistant, junior Chief of Staff, and Operations Coordinator. You are energized by turning chaos into clarity. You enjoy reading long, messy threads or transcripts and turning them into a single page of what matters: decisions, owners, deadlines, and risks. You are not afraid to challenge unclear requests, ask hard questions, or send work back for improvement before it reaches the CEO. You thrive in a fast\-paced, tech\-enabled environment where speed, thinking from first principles, and continuous improvement are core expectations, not aspirations. You think in systems, not tasks; you take extreme ownership of outcomes; and you are motivated by helping build the performance and sales systems of a company with proven products and big ambitions.### **Company Culture \& Values**

* **Analytical Decision Making:** Data\-driven strategies guide our decisions.
* **Speed \& Agility:** We prioritize efficiency and speed in execution.
* **Strategic Focus:** Long\-term success through strategic actions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Relentless pursuit of excellence and growth.
* **Integrity \& Transparency:** Building trust through honesty and accountability.
* **Challenge\-Oriented:** Embracing challenges as opportunities for innovation.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
* Ability to make a significant impact on the growth and success of dental practices.
* Professional development and growth opportunities as we build advanced performance and sales systems.
* A collaborative and supportive remote work culture that values ownership and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities to be part of a global team with members from 9\+ different countries.

**Work Environment and Work Hours**
-----------------------------------

* Set\-up: Full\-time, Remote
* Schedule: Monday–Friday, for 7\.5 working hours between 6 AM and 5 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST).
* Shift options: 6 AM–2 PM (1st shift) ; 9 AM–5 PM (2nd shift)
* **Remote Work:** At DentistFind, we operate in a fully remote environment. We utilize a time\-tracking tool that captures screenshots at random intervals to ensure accountability and productivity. Candidates must be comfortable with this setup. ***If you have any concerns regarding the use of a time\-tracking tool, we strongly advise against applying to ensure alignment with our work practices.***

**The Team**
------------


You will be part of a dynamic and diverse team spread across the globe, including regions like Canada, the Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, Jamaica, Malaysia, Bangladesh, and India. As part of a remote\-first organization, the team values open communication, collaboration, and a shared commitment to the company’s mission. You will work closely with the marketing and sales team and various department heads, playing a pivotal role in ensuring alignment and advancing strategic objectives.**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
----------------------------------


DentistFind is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive, diverse team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.**How to Apply**
----------------


Interested candidates should submit their resume, cover letter, and any relevant portfolio pieces demonstrating their expertise and success stories. You are encouraged to apply directly through our official job board for a more streamlined application process. This ensures your application is reviewed promptly by our recruitment team. Click here to apply and become a part of our team.

As a rapidly growing dental marketing and technology partner, we empower dental practices with data\-driven strategies, cutting\-edge tools, and a relentless focus on measurable outcomes. Join us to be a part of a team that values innovation, efficiency, and client success.**Job Overview**
----------------


DentistFind is seeking a high\-caliber **Executive Assistant to the CEO / Operations Support Coordinator** to act as the CEO’s cognitive filter and execution engine. This role sits at the center of the business, turning messy conversations, scattered information, and raw meeting notes into clear decisions, structured plans, and reliable follow\-through across Sales, Marketing, HR, Client Success, and Operations. You will reduce CEO drag, improve meeting quality, coordinate cross\-functional work, and maintain the operating systems that keep the company moving quickly and intelligently. This is a fast\-paced, remote role for someone who thinks in systems, thrives on challenge, and wants to help build performance and sales machines for a growing, technology\-driven dental marketing company.
### **Key Responsibilities**

* **CEO Support \& Information Filtering:** Review and refine documents, reports, and updates before they reach the CEO to ensure they answer the original business question, include supporting data, and have clear owners and deadlines; send back low\-quality or incomplete work with specific, respectful feedback.
* **Meeting Preparation \& Pre\-Reads:** Prepare structured agendas and collect updates prior to leadership and project meetings; create concise pre\-reads that highlight key metrics, issues, and decisions required from the CEO and stakeholders.
* **Meeting Notes \& Action Tracking:** Take clear, structured notes during meetings, capturing decisions, owners, deadlines, and blockers; convert discussions into action items in project tools, follow\-up messages, and updated trackers.
* **Operating Systems \& Trackers:** Build, maintain, and improve operating systems such as CEO Review Trackers, meeting trackers, task and project trackers, performance/experiment logs, and sales/partner tracking sheets to ensure visibility and accountability.
* **SOPs \& Process Documentation:** Create, refine, and standardize SOPs, checklists, templates, and process documents for recurring workflows (e.g., onboarding, performance reviews, campaign launches, reporting cadences).
* **Performance System Support:** Support the design and maintenance of a performance system that logs tests and experiments, tracks results, documents debriefs, and standardizes winning approaches across clients.
* **Sales System Support:** Help structure and maintain a simple, visible sales system and partner pipeline by tracking leads, partner activities, stages, and outcomes, ensuring the CEO and team have clear visibility on revenue motion.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate follow\-ups, dependencies, and deliverables across Marketing, Development, Client Success, HR, and Operations to make sure work escalated to the CEO is complete, structured, and decision\-ready.
* **Analytics \& Executive Summaries:** Synthesize data, transcripts, and multi\-source information into concise executive summaries and decision briefs that allow the CEO to act quickly with clear context, options, and implications.
* **AI\-Enabled Workflows:** Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) to summarize long documents and meeting transcripts, draft SOPs and templates, structure messy information, and improve the clarity and quality of written communication.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other ad hoc tasks and special projects as assigned by the Manager or CEO.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Communications, Marketing, or a related field (required).
* **Professional Experience:** Minimum 5 years of experience in roles such as Executive Assistant to CEO/Founder/Senior Executive, Operations Coordinator/Online Business Manager, or Project Manager/Junior Chief of Staff in a service, tech, or marketing environment (required).
* **Remote Operations Experience:** Proven experience working in remote, distributed teams and collaborating across multiple time zones and cultures (required).
* **Executive Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; demonstrated ability to produce CEO\-ready briefs, structured meeting notes, and clear, actionable follow\-up messages (required).
* **Critical Thinking \& Judgment:** Strong ability to understand business objectives behind tasks, separate facts from assumptions, identify missing information, and challenge vague or low\-quality inputs constructively (required).
* **Organization \& Follow\-Through:** Highly organized, self\-motivated, and proactive; proven track record of managing multiple streams of work, tracking owners and deadlines, and consistently closing loops until completion (required).
* **Systems \& Process Orientation:** Ability to build, document, and maintain trackers, SOPs, checklists, and basic operating systems that improve clarity, speed, and accountability (required).
* **Tools \& Technology:** Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Drive) and at least one project management tool (e.g., Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Airtable); comfortable using meeting transcription tools and AI tools like ChatGPT for summarization and documentation (required).
* **Values Alignment:** Demonstrated commitment to analytical decision making, speed and agility, strategic/performance focus, continuous improvement, integrity, transparency, and thriving in challenging, fast\-paced environments (required).
* **Discretion \& Professionalism:** Proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism (required).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Experience:** Experience in marketing agencies, SaaS/technology businesses, healthcare, or dental\-related companies (preferred).
* **Founder/CEO Support:** Prior experience supporting a fast\-moving founder or CEO in a growth\-stage or entrepreneurial environment (preferred).
* **Sales/Client Service Context:** Exposure to recurring services, retainers, or subscription\-style businesses serving small or medium\-sized clients, especially in North America (preferred).
* **Process \& Playbook Development:** Experience creating SOPs, checklists, playbooks, or operating rhythms (e.g., weekly reviews, scorecards, meeting cadences) that improved team execution (preferred).
* **Data \& Reporting:** Comfort working with basic dashboards, reports, and performance metrics; experience helping to design or maintain simple reporting systems (preferred).
* **CRM \& Pipeline Familiarity**: Familiarity with CRM tools and basic pipeline tracking for leads, partners, or accounts (preferred).
* **Remote \& Cross\-Cultural Collaboration:** Strong history of working effectively with international remote teams (e.g., Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, India, etc.) and adapting communication style across cultures (preferred).
* **Project/Process Certifications**: Additional training or certifications in project management, operations, or process improvement (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean, Six Sigma) (preferred).
* **Transcript \& Content Synthesis:** Demonstrated ability to convert long\-form content—such as meeting transcripts, discovery calls, or strategy sessions—into concise, action\-oriented executive briefs (preferred).

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


The ideal candidate is a hybrid of an Executive Assistant, junior Chief of Staff, and Operations Coordinator. You are energized by turning chaos into clarity. You enjoy reading long, messy threads or transcripts and turning them into a single page of what matters: decisions, owners, deadlines, and risks. You are not afraid to challenge unclear requests, ask hard questions, or send work back for improvement before it reaches the CEO. You thrive in a fast\-paced, tech\-enabled environment where speed, thinking from first principles, and continuous improvement are core expectations, not aspirations. You think in systems, not tasks; you take extreme ownership of outcomes; and you are motivated by helping build the performance and sales systems of a company with proven products and big ambitions.### **Company Culture \& Values**

* **Analytical Decision Making:** Data\-driven strategies guide our decisions.
* **Speed \& Agility:** We prioritize efficiency and speed in execution.
* **Strategic Focus:** Long\-term success through strategic actions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Relentless pursuit of excellence and growth.
* **Integrity \& Transparency:** Building trust through honesty and accountability.
* **Challenge\-Oriented:** Embracing challenges as opportunities for innovation.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
* Ability to make a significant impact on the growth and success of dental practices.
* Professional development and growth opportunities as we build advanced performance and sales systems.
* A collaborative and supportive remote work culture that values ownership and continuous improvement.
* Opportunities to be part of a global team with members from 9\+ different countries.

**Work Environment and Work Hours**
-----------------------------------

* Set\-up: Full\-time, Remote
* Schedule: Monday–Friday, for 7\.5 working hours between 6 AM and 5 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST).
* Shift options: 6 AM–2 PM (1st shift) ; 9 AM–5 PM (2nd shift)
* **Remote Work:** At DentistFind, we operate in a fully remote environment. We utilize a time\-tracking tool that captures screenshots at random intervals to ensure accountability and productivity. Candidates must be comfortable with this setup. ***If you have any concerns regarding the use of a time\-tracking tool, we strongly advise against applying to ensure alignment with our work practices.***

**The Team**
------------


You will be part of a dynamic and diverse team spread across the globe, including regions like Canada, the Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, Indonesia, Jamaica, Malaysia, Bangladesh, and India. As part of a remote\-first organization, the team values open communication, collaboration, and a shared commitment to the company’s mission. You will work closely with the marketing and sales team and various department heads, playing a pivotal role in ensuring alignment and advancing strategic objectives.**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
----------------------------------


DentistFind is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive, diverse team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, cover letter, and any relevant portfolio pieces demonstrating their expertise and success stories. You are encouraged to apply directly through our official job board for a more streamlined application process. This ensures your application is reviewed promptly by our recruitment team. title: Demo Systems Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As the **Manager of Demo Systems Specialists**, you will lead and scale a technical team responsible for building, maintaining, and innovating Rippling’s pre\-sales demo environments. You will serve as the strategic bridge between technical infrastructure and field execution, ensuring our Solutions Consulting (SC) and Sales organizations have a flawless, high\-impact product story to show prospects.


In this role, you will not only manage daily operations and troubleshooting queues, but you will also drive the long\-term vision for our demo architecture, cross\-functional data alignment, and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Team Leadership \& Development**

* **Manage and Mentor:** Lead a growing team of Demo Systems Specialists, providing coaching, career development, and technical guidance.
* **Resource Allocation:** Oversee sprint planning, ticket triaging, and project assignments to ensure the team effectively balances daily support requests with long\-term infrastructure projects.
* **Culture:** Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance engineering culture aligned with Rippling's values.

### **Strategic Operations \& Innovation**

* **Environment Architecture:** Own the roadmap for our demo environments, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and equipped with realistic, high\-fidelity data sets.
* **Release Management:** Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure demo environments seamlessly absorb the latest product releases without disrupting active sales cycles.
* **Data\-Driven Improvement:** Establish KPIs and track analytics around demo downtime, top technical issues, and support turnaround times to proactively improve environment infrastructure.
* **Knowledge Management:** Oversee the creation and upkeep of robust internal documentation, standardizing demo setup procedures and troubleshooting workflows for the broader SC organization.

### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* **Field Alignment:** Serve as the primary escalation point for Sales and Solutions Consulting leadership regarding critical demo environment needs.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** Translate recurring demo technical issues into actionable feedback for Core Product and Engineering teams to improve overall product stability.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required; Master's degree in business or related field preferred
* Minimum 2 years in a technical support management role.
* Strong technical curiosity – ability to quickly learn complex SaaS systems and troubleshoot configurations.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills – comfortable flexing between technical engineers and non\-technical field\-facing stakeholders.
* Passion for creating seamless, high\-impact demo experiences.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Manager, Payroll and HRIS
description:
**Join TRG Screen: Building World\-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.**



Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?



At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting\-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.



Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.


**About TRG Screen**

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission\-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.



TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's largest and most respected private equity firms.


**The Role:**



We are seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Manager – Payroll and HRIS Systems** to join our India team. This role requires a seasoned professional with **10\+ years of expertise in managing payroll operations and HRIS platforms** across multiple regions and HR analytics. You will lead a small payroll team, oversee **global payroll delivery**, and ensure the **accuracy, compliance, and integrity of HR systems** while driving process improvements


**Responsibilities (Core Focus – Global Payroll)**


* Manage and process end\-to\-end global payroll across multiple regions, with a focus on the US, UK, and APAC, ensuring compliance with statutory regulations and company policies.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant payroll processing, including tax filings, benefits administration, and reporting.
* Partner with HR, Finance, and external vendors to streamline payroll processes for efficiency and scalability.
* Develop, implement, and document standard payroll procedures to ensure consistency and compliance across regions.
* Act as the primary point of contact for payroll audits, handling reconciliations, compliance checks, and issue resolution.
* Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the payroll team to foster accuracy, accountability, and operational excellence.


**Nice to Have (HRIS \& Analytics)**


* Oversee the administration and maintenance of HRIS platforms, ensuring data accuracy, system integrity, and seamless integration of changes.
* Monitor HRIS system performance and coordinate with vendors/IT teams for enhancements, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Lead HR analytics and reporting efforts, including designing dashboards and reports on headcount, attrition, compensation, and workforce trends.
* Provide insights on workforce planning, cost optimization, and employee demographics, supporting leadership with data\-driven recommendations.


**Job Requirements:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in payroll management, HRIS administration, and HR analytics.
* Strong knowledge of global payroll processes, compliance requirements, and statutory regulations.
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms such as ADP Workforce Now, Greenhouse ATS, and Quantum Workforce (preferred).
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, HR dashboards, and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for analytics and reporting.
* Proven ability to manage multiple payrolls across regions in a multinational environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor a team, while influencing cross\-functional stakeholders.


Join TRG Screen and unlock your potential in an environment where innovation thrives, opportunities abound, and your contributions make a difference. We are an equal opportunities employer. We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.  

  

At TRG Screen, we understand that diverse and inclusive teams are not just beneficial, they are essential to our success. We recognize that embracing diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fosters innovation, enhances problem\-solving capabilities, and drives better business outcomes. By cultivating a culture of inclusion where every voice is heard and valued, we empower our world class teams to thrive, excel, and drive positive change.  

  

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.



**Privacy Notice for Applicants**



TRG Screen is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. Information you provide during the recruitment process will be collected, processed, and stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy.



We encourage all applicants to review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data throughout the recruitment process. Our Privacy Policy is available at: www.trgscreen.com/privacy\-policy.



By submitting an application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our Privacy Policy.

\* Reduced hiring turnaround time.

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.

* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.

title: People & Culture Manager
description:
**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world\-class employee experience and company culture.
  

  

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.


**About the location:**

Open since May 2019, in the information technology capital of India, Four Seasons Hotel Bengaluru at Embassy ONE provides a preferred address for both business and leisure travellers, and the highly personalized, anticipatory service that Four Seasons guests expect and value around the world. Designed to reflect a sense of its location, the Hotel’s design merges nature and architecture in an homage to Bengaluru’s reputation as the Garden City. Four Seasons Hotel Bengaluru at Embassy ONE is located in one of the city’s most dynamic development that includes Four Seasons Private Residences, premium grade office space, sophisticated retail, dining and entertainment.
**About the role**

The **People \& Culture Manager** is responsible for leading recruitment, employee relations, learning and development, benefits administration, HR operations, and compliance initiatives to support business objectives and enhance the employee experience. This role partners with department leaders to attract, develop, and retain top talent, oversee onboarding and training programs, manage HR reporting and workforce planning, and ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies. The People \& Culture Manager also drives employee engagement activities, supervises the HR team, administers employee benefits, and fosters a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance workplace culture.
**What you will do**

* As a strategic business partner, this role works closely with department leaders to foster a positive workplace culture, attract and retain top talent, ensure legal compliance, and deliver exceptional employee experiences aligned with organizational goals and values.
* Assume the responsibilities of recruitment for the Director of Human Resources in their absence.
* Supervise, train and counsel the team in their daily functions.
* Monitor and ensure compliance with the staffing procedures as it relates to job requisitions. Coordinate, administer and implement all employee personal files prior to commencement of their job. Ensure that accurate job descriptions, policies, corporate policies are signed and filed in respective HR file of the employee concerned.
* Produce monthly HR reports with the use of the Workday reports and distribute to respective Division Heads (e.g: turnover reports, promotions, new hires, salary comparisons, accidents, injuries, sick leave).
* Administer the Apprenticeship and Internship Program with the assistance of the Learning Manager.
* Participate in community recruiting events including job fairs, local colleges/university.
* Ensure the employee restaurant is clean, the food is well prepared and that there are appropriate decorations for holidays and special events.
* Ensure all employee medical and insurance benefits are administered accurately and employee claims are handled on a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain the job posting system internally and on the Four Seasons career watch and local website.
* Monitor whether accurate count of employee additions and deletions with back up for Insurance provider on a monthly basis and provide support to annual budget process regarding all benefit plans.
* Organize and maintain legally compliant records as applicable under but not limited to Shops \& Establishment Act, Employee Provident Fund Act, Employee State Insurance Act, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act etc. including all monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual and annual reports.
* Lead, coach, and develop the People \& Culture team.
* Provide guidance and support to managers on people\-related matters.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the People \& Culture lead in the absence of the Director of People \& Culture.

**What you bring**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* 8\-9 years of progressive HR experience, preferably within hospitality, luxury hotels, or customer\-focused organizations.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, employee relations, learning and development, and employment legislation.
* Experience managing HR systems such as Workday or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices
* Professional HR certification is an advantage,

**What we offer:**

### **·****Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package**

### **·****Excellent Training and Development opportunities including an international career.**

### **·****Complimentary Dream Holidays at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts**

### **·****Comprehensive Insurance coverage for Hospitalization and Personal Accident**

description:

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud\-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.


How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work\-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first\-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Senior HR Business Partner**

We have an opportunity for a **Senior HR Business Partner** to join our People \& Places (Human Resources) team in Bangalore, India, reporting to the Director, HR Business Partner. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders in a global, matrixed environment—shaping people strategies that fuel growth, innovation, and a strong, inclusive culture. Collaborating closely with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Development, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, People Operations) and cross\-functional business stakeholders, you will drive data\- and AI\-informed people decisions, lead complex organizational change, and champion a compelling employee experience that helps every Bloxer do the best work of their career.


You will combine business acumen, data\-driven insights, and HR expertise, while ensuring strong regulatory compliance and ethical standards, to deliver impactful outcomes at scale. You will embody our values, acting with integrity and transparency, championing belonging and respect, and approaching every challenge with a growth mindset and collaborative spirit.


**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Partner with senior business leaders as a strategic HR advisor to translate business objectives into integrated people plans across workforce planning, org design, talent, and culture
* Lead key people processes for assigned client groups, including performance cycles, talent reviews, succession planning, promotions, and organizational changes
* Use people data, dashboards, and AI\-driven insights (e.g., Oracle HCM analytics, HR reporting tools) to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and recommend business\-focused actions
* Coach managers and leaders on performance management, feedback, difficult conversations, and change leadership, enabling strong, high\-performing teams
* Manage complex employee relations matters with a fair, structured, and risk\-aware approach, in line with Infoblox policies and local labor laws
