* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, internal policies, and global HR standards, maintaining audit readiness in partnership with Legal and People Operations
* Leverage AI and digital HR tools (e.g., AskHR chatbot, Oracle HCM, Microsoft 365/Power BI) to streamline workflows and enhance the employee and manager experience
* Translate market trends and workforce analytics into actionable recommendations on talent, internal mobility, organizational effectiveness, and future skills
* Foster a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, and bias\-toward\-action decision\-making, holding yourself and others accountable with transparency and care

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including HRBP partnership with senior leaders in a global, matrixed environment
* Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and deliver results across competing priorities
* Strong expertise in employee relations, leadership coaching, organizational development, and change management
* Analytical mindset with experience using HR analytics, dashboards, and AI\-enabled insights (e.g., Oracle HCM, survey analytics) to inform decisions
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted, credible relationships across all levels of the organization
* Digital and AI fluency across HR and productivity platforms (Oracle HCM, ServiceNow/AskHR, Microsoft or Google suite)
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law and HR best practices, with experience ensuring compliance while enabling business agility
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources or a related field; HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, CIPD, HR AI/IS, Project Management) are a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.


Six Months:


* Establish trusted partnerships with senior leaders and become a go\-to advisor on people, culture, and organizational topics
* Lead or materially shape performance, talent review, and succession planning cycles for your business areas, leveraging AI\-driven insights
* Improve key people metrics (attrition, internal mobility, engagement) through targeted action plans co\-created with business leaders
* Partner with HR COEs to localize and implement at least one major HR initiative for India with strong change management
* Deliver at least two process improvements that leverage digital or AI tools to reduce manual HR work and enhance employee experience

One Year:


* Be recognized as a strategic thought partner shaping the long\-term people agenda, workforce strategy, and org design for your business areas
* Demonstrate measurable impact on engagement, internal fill rates, regrettable attrition, and succession readiness through sustained programs
* Lead or co\-lead multi\-country or cross\-functional HR initiatives that improve process efficiency, governance, and employee experience at scale
* Embed AI\-enabled and data\-driven decision\-making into day\-to\-day people processes and mentor HR peers on effective use
* Champion a culture of inclusion and psychological safety with visible improvements in feedback, collaboration, and trust

**Belong —** Your Community


Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.


**Be Rewarded —** Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong


* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options

* Establish and implement HR policies, procedures, and employment contracts in full compliance with Indian labor laws, including the recent labor codes effective from November 2025\.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with employees at all levels, as well as with headquarters stakeholders.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Experience in the electronics, automotive, or connector manufacturing industry.
* Experience supporting a newly established entity in India from an HR setup perspective.



  





  





**Pay Range and Compensation Package** 




  





  





 Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Opportunity to work in a dynamic, multinational environment with career development and growth opportunities within a fast\-growing global company.
 



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





  





 We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
Prompt Engineer (Fresher / Entry\-Level)

**Company:** Physiqo **Location:** \[ Remote ] **Experience:** 0–1 year (Freshers welcome) **Employment Type:** Part Time **Department:** AI / Product

About Physiqo

Physiqo is building AI\-powered health and fitness experiences that help people understand their bodies better and reach their fitness goals faster. We're a fast\-moving, product\-first team looking for curious, detail\-oriented people to help shape how our AI systems think, talk, and respond to users.

About the Role

As a Prompt Engineer at Physiqo, you'll design, test, and refine the prompts and instructions that power our AI features — from conversational coaching to personalized recommendations. You'll work closely with product, ML, and design teams to make sure our AI responses are accurate, safe, on\-brand, and genuinely helpful to users.

This is a great role for someone who loves language, logic, and problem\-solving, and wants to get hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs) in a real product setting. No prior professional experience is required — we're looking for strong fundamentals and a fast learning curve.

What You'll Do

* Write, test, and iterate on prompts for LLM\-powered features (chat, recommendations, content generation, etc.)
* Break down user needs and product requirements into clear, structured prompt instructions
* Run systematic experiments to compare prompt variations and measure output quality
* Identify and fix failure modes — hallucinations, inconsistent tone, unsafe or irrelevant responses
* Build and maintain a library of reusable prompt templates and evaluation criteria
* Collaborate with engineers to integrate prompts into the product and set up feedback loops
* Analyze user interactions and outputs to spot patterns and suggest improvements
* Stay current with LLM capabilities, prompting techniques, and industry best practices
* Document your prompt designs, decisions, and learnings for the team

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Linguistics, English, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Strong written English — clarity, precision, and structure in communication
* Genuine interest in AI/LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) — personal projects or experimentation count
* Basic understanding of how LLMs work (tokens, context windows, temperature, etc.) — or eagerness to learn quickly
* Analytical mindset — comfortable breaking problems into logical steps and testing hypotheses
* Basic familiarity with Python (helpful, not mandatory)
* Attention to detail and a habit of double\-checking edge cases
* Curiosity, patience, and comfort with iteration (a lot of prompt engineering is trial and error)

Nice to Have

* Experience using the OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google AI APIs (even personal projects)
* Familiarity with prompt frameworks (few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, ReAct, etc.)
* Exposure to fitness, nutrition, or health\-tech domains
* Basic knowledge of data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, or Python/pandas)

What You'll Get

* Hands\-on experience building real AI products used by real users from day one
* Mentorship from experienced product and ML team members
* A steep learning curve in one of the fastest\-growing fields in tech

How to Apply

Send your resume along with:

* A short note on why you're interested in prompt engineering / AI
* (Optional but encouraged) Examples of prompts you've written or AI tools you've experimented with

**Apply at:** career@physiqo.in (Send you resume on this Email)

*Physiqo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.*

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Research \& Process Improvement

* Monitor price trends of key engineering and solar materials.

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **Procurement Executive** with experience in the architecture, interior design, and construction industry. The candidate should have a strong understanding of construction materials, interior finishes, vendor management, project procurement, and supply chain coordination. The role involves sourcing quality materials, managing vendors, maintaining procurement timelines, and ensuring cost\-effective purchasing for multiple projects.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

title: Python Developer Intern
description:
Based on current job postings across India for **Python/Django Interns**, companies looking to hire emerging developers typically require a specific mix of core programming skills, backend familiarity, and practical tools.

To help you design a curriculum that gets your students hired or to write an attractive job description to hire one yourself, here is what the industry actually expects from a Python/Django intern.

Technical Skills RequiredCore Python Programming

Interns aren't expected to know everything about architecture, but they must be completely comfortable with writing clean, functional Python.

* **Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP):** Solid grip on classes, inheritance, and functions.
* **Data Structures:** Mastery over lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and basic algorithms.
* **Virtual Environments:** Ability to use venv or virtualenv to manage package dependencies cleanly.

Django \& Backend Web Development

* **MVT Architecture:** Understanding Model\-View\-Template pattern and how data flows through a Django app.
* **Django ORM \& Databases:** Ability to write database queries using Python code instead of raw SQL, write migrations (makemigrations, migrate), and link tables (One\-to\-Many, Many\-to\-Many).
* **Django REST Framework (DRF):** Almost every Python web internship demands basic knowledge of REST APIs. Interns should know how to use **Serializers**, **APIViews/ViewSets**, and handle JSON data.
* **Authentication \& Security:** Familiarity with user login/registration flows, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), or session\-based authentication.

Essential Tools \& Infrastructure

* **Version Control (Git/GitHub):** The absolute \#1 requirement. Knowing how to branch, commit, push, and create pull requests without breaking the codebase.
* **Databases:** Hands\-on experience with **PostgreSQL** or **MySQL** (moving beyond just default local SQLite).
* **API Testing Tools:** Ability to test endpoints independently using **Postman** or **cURL**.

Soft Skills \& Daily Responsibilities

When companies hire Python/Django interns, their typical daily tasks include:

* **Writing \& Debugging Code:** Fixing small bugs in existing backend services or writing minor helper scripts.
* **API Integration:** Connecting the backend with third\-party APIs (like payment gateways, SMS providers, or AI models).
* **Collaborating with Frontend:** Working alongside React/Flutter developers by delivering clean JSON endpoints for them to consume.
* **Documentation:** Writing clear API docs and maintaining clean README.md files.

What Makes an Intern Stand Out (Bonus Skills)

If a student wants to comfortably clear interviews at tech hubs like Infopark or Bangalore, having any of these gives an immediate edge over freshers:

* **Basic Cloud/Deployment:** Knowing how to deploy an app to a live server (VPS like Ubuntu/DigitalOcean, Render, or AWS EC2\).
* **Docker Basics:** Understanding how to containerize a Django app.
* **AI/ML Integration:** Since many Python backends power AI tools, basic exposure to integrating OpenAI/LLM APIs into a Django backend is highly valued right now.

Pay: From ₹10,000\.00 per month

**About Taxplan**

 Taxplan is building an organized ecosystem for taxation and compliance services by combining professional expertise, technology, consultant network and customer\-focused service delivery.
   






**Role Summary** 





 We are looking for a dynamic, responsible and target\-oriented Business Development \& Revenue Manager who will be responsible for driving business growth and revenue for Taxplan.
 





 The candidate will be responsible for corporate tie\-ups, partnerships, client acquisition, lead conversion, revenue generation and managing Taxplan's Business Development interns.
 





 This is not only a sales role. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of revenue, build a structured business development process, manage interns, track performance and convert market opportunities into actual business.
 




**Compensation:** 

 Approx. ₹6 LPA. Performance\-based incentives may be considered based on revenue achievement.
 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Generate new business opportunities for Taxplan through direct outreach, networking and referral channels.
* Identify and approach potential clients across segments — individuals, SMEs, business owners, housing societies, associations, educational institutions and startup communities — for Taxplan's taxation, GST, accounting and compliance services.
* Convert leads into paying clients and ensure monthly revenue targets are achieved.
* Create and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients, partners and referral sources.
* Prepare and present Taxplan's business proposals to prospective clients and partners.
* Regularly follow up with leads and ensure timely closures.



**2\. Corporate Tie\-Ups \& Strategic Partnerships** 



* Build formal, ongoing tie\-ups with companies for employee tax filing programs, GST/accounting support, compliance services and advisory retainers.
* Develop relationships with HR teams, finance departments, business associations, startup networks and professional networks to establish Taxplan as their preferred compliance partner.
* Explore partnership opportunities with consultants, CA firms, educational institutions, banks and fintech companies for referral or co\-service arrangements.
* Negotiate and finalize commercial terms, proposals and collaboration models with management for corporate and institutional partnerships.


- 


**3\. BD Intern Team Handling** 



* Manage, guide and monitor Taxplan's Business Development interns.
* Assign daily and weekly business development targets to interns.
* Train interns on Taxplan's services, sales pitch, client handling and lead generation process.
* Track intern attendance, discipline, productivity and reporting.
* Review lead sheets, follow\-up status and conversion progress.
* Motivate interns and ensure their outreach activities result in measurable leads and revenue.
* Conduct regular review meetings with interns and report progress to management.



**4\. Sales Planning \& Execution** 



* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly business development plans.
* Set clear targets for self and interns.
* Track leads, meetings, follow\-ups, conversions and revenue.
* Maintain proper CRM / Excel / Google Sheet records of prospects, clients and partnerships.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth client onboarding and handover to the concerned Taxplan service team.
* Analyze sales performance and suggest improvements in strategy.
* Represent Taxplan professionally in corporate meetings, networking events, seminars and institutional discussions.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong business development and sales ability.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle corporate meetings and partnership discussions.
* Leadership ability to manage interns and junior team members.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and negotiation skills.
* Target\-oriented and revenue\-focused mindset.
* Ability to maintain reports, lead trackers and performance dashboards.
* Basic understanding of taxation, GST, accounting or compliance services will be preferred.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment with ownership and accountability.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM tools.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* 3 to 6 years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, Corporate Tie\-ups, Institutional Sales, Client Acquisition or Revenue Generation.
* Experience in fintech, taxation, CA firms, compliance services, financial services, banking, insurance, SaaS, edtech, HR services or professional services will be preferred.
* Prior experience in handling interns, field sales executives or junior sales teams will be an added advantage.



  





**Education** 





 Graduate / MBA / PG in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related field.
 





 MBA is preferred but not compulsory if the candidate has strong practical sales and business development experience.
 




  





**Key Performance Indicators** 



* Monthly revenue generated.
* Number of corporate tie\-ups closed.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of paying clients converted.
* Number of meetings conducted.
* Intern productivity and lead conversion.
* Number of strategic partnerships developed.
* CRM / reporting accuracy.
* Follow\-up discipline.
* Contribution to Taxplan's overall growth.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 





 The ideal candidate should be a self\-driven business development professional who can work closely with the founders and take ownership of revenue.
 





 We are not looking for only a “sales talker.” We are looking for a person who can manage people, maintain reports, take regular follow\-ups, convert leads, guide interns and build a proper revenue system for Taxplan.
 





 The candidate should be mature, disciplined, target\-driven and capable of representing Taxplan professionally in the market.
 




  





**Reporting** 




**Reports To:** 

 Management / Founders of Taxplan Advisors Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Working / Reporting Office:** 

 Vasai West
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Business Development \& Revenue Manager will be responsible for driving client acquisition, nurturing existing relationships, and identifying new growth opportunities for RMH Advisors. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Virar includes developing and executing revenue strategies, preparing proposals, and presenting service offerings to prospective and current clients. The role involves collaborating with internal teams to align service delivery with client needs, tracking performance against targets, and reporting progress to leadership. The manager will also analyze market trends, participate in networking activities, and support marketing initiatives to strengthen the firm’s presence and generate qualified leads.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and negotiation capabilities.
* Candidates should possess financial and analytical skills, such as understanding accounting and tax concepts, interpreting financial data, and developing revenue forecasts.
* Candidates should possess communication and presentation skills, including clear written and verbal communication, proposal writing, and client\-facing presentation abilities.

* Comfort with using CRM tools, productivity software, and digital platforms to manage sales activities and reporting.

description:
This position is part of the Asia Pacific Human Resources team and sits in the Workplaces Practices Centre of Excellence, reporting to APAC WP Director.
   

  

 We are seeking India Workplace Practices Lead, highly skilled in
 **Employee Relations (ER) investigations and** 
 the ability to
 **partner across stakeholders and influence policy design** 
 . This role is responsible for conducting fair, thorough, and timely investigations into workplace concerns, while identifying systemic issues and contributing to
 **policy enhancement and preventive ER strategies** 
 .
   

  

* Work Environment investigations\- Partner with internal employment counsel, compliance and HR Business Partners to effectively manage employee relations issues/investigations
* Policies \& processes\- Drive continuous improvement in ER processes, policies, framework and ensuring compliance with labor laws.
* Training \& awareness: Build preventive ER capability through manager training and employee awareness sessions.
* Extend support to investigations and projects across APAC on need basis.


 Based in Gurgaon India you work with teams across India and extend support to the APAC region
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Leads and conducts Work Environment investigations for a high\-volume portfolio of cases across India. Including intake processes, investigation planning and interviews, recommendation and determination, and reporting/insights analysis. Communicates and updates status of investigations to relevant managers and HRBPs. Makes recommendations to HRBPs and leadership regarding investigations and employee relations issues.
* Analyzes and report WE investigations, employee relations and other data trends to address and mitigate risk and support and drive our culture of integrity. Partners with HR and managers to drive necessary improvements.
* Provide sound ER advice and guidance to HRBPs and managers on a range of ER topics such as RIFs, performance management, merger and acquisition, disciplinary processes, absence management and managing risk in termination of employment within the framework of leading with care.
* Build preventive ER capability through manager training and employee awareness sessions on respectful workplace, investigations process, handling performance issues, conflict resolution, conduct concerns, and difficult conversations.
* Strengthen team\-level trust, psychological safety, and communication by identifying patterns, early\-warning indicators and building a speak up culture.
* Contribute to the development of policies, processes, and training materials that support a culture of accountability and integrity.
* Coordinates with compliance and legal regarding employee discipline for compliance investigations that are not work environment matters. May also assist in these investigations.
* Maintains knowledge of current and emerging laws and regulations, and periodically reviews and updates applicable standards, trends and issues affecting the company work environment and policies.
* Independently manage/support special projects in addition to other required responsibilities


 What You Need:
   

  

* Proven 10\+ years of work experience
* 4\-5 years of expereince in handling complex investigations and senior stakeholder engagement
* Experience in HR policy drafting or influencing organizational policies
* Knowledge of employment laws or legal background would be preferred.
* Understanding of AI tools for pattern recognition and evidence analysis
* Critical thinking – you evaluate conflicting accounts and identify inconsistencies, spot repeated behaviors or systemic concerns
* Confidentiality: Ability to handle sensitive conversations with professionalism and empathy
* Cultural awareness – respect diverse perspectives and contexts
* Proven ability to collaborate and influence stakeholders at multiple levels

 4–8 years
 



**About Kusvaa** 





 Kusvaa is a women\-led Indian fashion brand celebrating India's textile heritage through handblock prints and ethnic wear for women, kids, and men. With retail stores across Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, and Vadodara, a fast\-growing online store, and a social media community of 260K\+, we're scaling quickly — and we need someone to build the people function that grows with us.
 



**The Role** 




 As our HR Manager, you'll be the first dedicated HR hire and will own the full people function end\-to\-end — from hiring retail store teams and corporate staff to building the policies, processes, and culture of a growing consumer brand.
 



**What You'll Do**

* 4–8 years of HR generalist experience, ideally in retail, fashion, D2C, or a multi\-location consumer business

description:
**About 1\.5degree
 



 1\.5degree is one of the fastest\-growing ice cream QSR brands, with its own in\-house manufacturing setup powering rapid outlet expansion. As we scale, we’re looking for an HR Manager who can build and run people processes that keep pace with a high\-growth, multi\-location, manufacturing\-plus\-retail environment.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We’re looking for an HR Manager with a proven track record in a similarly fast\-scaling F\&B/QSR or ice cream manufacturing setup, someone who has managed HR across both factory/plant and retail outlet teams, and who is comfortable using AI\-powered tools and HR software (Keka, Kasturi, or similar platforms) to run payroll, recruitment, and appraisals efficiently at scale.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Payroll \& Compliance: Manage end\-to\-end payroll processing for plant and outlet staff, ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, labour laws), and maintain accurate attendance\-to\-payroll workflows.
 



 • Recruitment: Drive hiring across manufacturing, retail/outlet, and corporate roles to support rapid store and plant expansion; build scalable, tech\-enabled hiring pipelines.
 



 • Performance Appraisals: Design and run structured appraisal cycles, KRA/KPI frameworks, and performance review processes using HRMS tools.
 



 • HR Systems \& AI Tools: Leverage HRMS platforms (Kasturi or equivalent — Keka, Zoho People, greytHR, etc.) and AI\-based tools to streamline attendance tracking, payroll accuracy, reporting, and HR analytics.
 



 • Policy \& Culture: Develop and implement HR policies suited to a factory \+ retail hybrid workforce; drive engagement and retention across blue\-collar and white\-collar teams.
 



 • Stakeholder Management: Partner closely with plant heads, outlet operations, and leadership to align HR practices with business growth targets.
 



 Requirements
 



 • Experience: \~5 years of HR generalist experience, with meaningful exposure to a fast\-growing QSR/F\&B startup with its own manufacturing unit (ice cream or similar perishable/FMCG manufacturing preferred).
 



 • Software Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with HRMS/payroll software such as Kasturi, Keka, greytHR, Zoho People, or similar, along with comfort using AI\-based HR tools for recruitment screening, payroll processing, and performance tracking.
 



 • Core Skills: Strong grasp of payroll processing, statutory compliance, recruitment lifecycle management, and performance appraisal frameworks.
 



 • Education: MBA/PGDM in Human Resources (or equivalent relevant degree); additional certifications in HR analytics or HRMS tools are a plus.
 



 • Other: Ability to manage HR for a dual workforce — plant/manufacturing staff and retail/outlet teams — with strong stakeholder management and multitasking ability.
 



 Preferred
 



 • Prior experience in an ice cream, dairy, bakery, or similar perishable\-goods manufacturing environment.
 



 • Experience scaling HR processes during periods of rapid outlet/unit expansion.**

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work reactively on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience

 Our India Technology Center (ITC) is a rapidly growing organization supporting global technology and digital initiatives across Williams\-Sonoma. With a strong base of engineering and product talent, ITC plays a critical role in delivering innovation, scalability, and business impact across our global platforms.
   

  

 The HR team partners closely with Technology leadership and associates to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent. We are focused on building high\-performing teams, delivering data\-driven people solutions, and fostering an inclusive, high\-performance culture aligned with global priorities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior HR Manager is a strategic, hands\-on partner who will play a key role in shaping the people agenda for the India Technology Center (ITC). In this role, you will work closely with senior Technology leaders (Director/VP level), helping translate business priorities into meaningful people strategies that enable teams to do their best work.
   

  

 You’ll be at the heart of building a high\-performing, inclusive, and scalable organization—driving initiatives across HR Business Partnership, Talent Development, and HR Operations. From strengthening leadership capability to enhancing employee experience, your work will directly impact how our teams grow and succeed.
   

  

 While you will partner closely with Talent Acquisition leadership to ensure hiring strategies are aligned with business needs and support ITC’s continued growth, the scope of this role may evolve over time to include broader responsibilities in this area.
   

  

 You’ll also partner with U.S. and global HR teams, gaining exposure to a truly international environment and helping bring together global best practices with local insights.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**Business Partnership**
* Partner with Technology leaders to align workforce strategy with business goals, including org design and workforce planning
* Provide coaching to managers on leadership capability, performance management, and team effectiveness
* Use HR analytics to identify trends (attrition, engagement, performance) and recommend actionable interventions
* Support and lead change management initiatives with structured execution and communication


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**

title: V.I.E India - Business Analyst & Finance Support (Renewable Energy)
description:
Mexens is an independent international renewable energy developer and investor, active in solar PV and energy transition projects across several geographies.
   

  

 India is a strategic growth market for the Group, with ambitious development targets in utility‑scale solar and BESS, C\&I projects, and selective M\&A, supported by a local team and strong interactions with Head Office (Europe).
   

  

 As part of the strengthening of our Indian platform, we are opening a V.I.E position combining Business Analysis and Finance / Reporting support, with strong exposureto international management.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 As V.I.E – Business Analyst \& Finance Support, you will act as a key support function to the Indian subsidiary, while working in close coordination with Group HQ teams (strategy, finance, international).
   

  

**Your Role Will Focus On**
* Market \& business analysis to support growth and development decisions.
* Accounting \& finance support, with a strong emphasis on setting up tools, reporting, and robust processes, and improving cooperation between India and HQ.


 This position is designed as a structuring role, ideal for a young professional looking for international exposure at the crossroads of strategy, finance, and operations.
   

  

****Main  Responsibilities****
* Business \& Market Analysis (Core Responsibility)
* Monitor and analyse the Indian renewable energy market:
* Solar PV (utility\-scale, C\&I), BESS
* tariffs, tenders, regulatory developments,
* competitors, IPPs, EPCs and investors.
* Prepare market intelligence notes and synthesis for the India management team and HQ.
* Support business development activities:
* opportunity screening (greenfield, tenders, partnerships),
* preparation of internal notes and decision materials.
* Contribute to India roadmap updates and strategic presentations for Group management.
* Accounting \& Finance Support – Tools, Reporting \& Processes (Key Focus)
* Support the finance \& accounting structuring of the Indian subsidiary in coordination with HQ.
* Help design, improve and document:
* financial reporting tools (monthly reporting, dashboards),
* budget tracking and cost monitoring,
* project‑level financial follow‑up (basic level).
* Act as a relay between the India team and HQ finance:
* ensure consistency of formats, data and assumptions,
* improve clarity, reliability and timeliness of reporting.
* Contribute to the definition and implementation of right processes:
* workflows,
* reporting calendars,
* responsibilities and interfaces between India and HQ.
* Support ad‑hoc financial analyses requested by management (scenario analysis, basic cash flow views, etc.).
* Cross‑functional \& Coordination Role
* Coordinate inputs between:
* local India teams (development, operations),
* Group HQ teams (finance, strategy, international).
* Contribute to improving internal communication and cooperation, especially on finance‑ and data‑driven topics.
* Participate in internal reviews and meetings (local and international).


****Profile \& Skills****
**Education**
* Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Energy or equivalent.
* Strong interest in renewable energy, infrastructure or emerging markets.


**Skills \& Experience**
* First experience (internship/graduate level) in business analysis, consulting, finance, audit, project finance or strategy is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and structured thinking.
* Very good command of Excel (reporting, analysis); PowerPoint required.
* Interest in process design, tools and interface roles between teams.


**Languages**
* Fluent English (working language).
* Fluent French.
* Knowledge of Hindi or other Indian languages is an advantage, not mandatory.


**Soft Skills**
* Rigorous, reliable and detail‑oriented.
* Proactive, hands‑on and adaptable.
* Comfortable working in a multicultural, fast‑growing, entrepreneurial environment.
* Strong communication skills with both local teams and international HQ.


**What We Offer**
* A high‑impact international role in one of the most dynamic renewable energy markets worldwide.
* Real exposure to strategy, business development and finance structuring.
* A unique opportunity to build tools, improve processes and leave a tangible footprint.
* Close interaction with senior management in India and at Group level.
* Strong learning curve and visibility within the Group.

title: Client Services Analyst I
description:
**Who We Are**
 Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 As a Client Services Analyst you will play a key role in delivering Zinnia’s software platforms and business solutions to our clients. This role serves as a primary liaison between clients, internal delivery teams, and implementation leadership, ensuring client requirements are clearly understood, documented, and successfully delivered. You will be responsible for requirements analysis, documentation, solution design, and client support throughout the implementation lifecycle, while fostering strong client relationships and maintaining high standards of service delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Client Relationship \& Support Management**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing both voice and non\-voice communications during US shift.
* Provide timely support for client issues, service requests, system defects, and business queries while meeting defined SLAs.
* Analyze reported issues, perform initial troubleshooting, coordinate with internal teams, and provide regular status updates until resolution.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships by understanding client business objectives, operational processes, and product requirements.
* Conduct client meetings, status calls, requirement discussions, issue reviews, and stakeholder communications.


**Business Analysis, Project Delivery \& Release Management**
* Gather, analyze, validate, and document business requirements, translating client needs into BRDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, and solution specifications.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, gap analysis sessions, impact assessments, and solution discussions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Evaluate enhancement requests and recommend optimal business and technical solutions aligned with client objectives.
* Prepare Statements of Work (SOW), effort estimates, cost estimates, change requests, and impact assessments for client enhancements.
* Act as the liaison between clients and cross\-functional teams including Product Management, Development, QA, and Infrastructure
* Coordinate end\-to\-end delivery activities including requirement gathering, development support, testing, UAT, release planning, deployment, and post\-production validation.
* Collaborate with QA teams to define test scenarios, acceptance criteria, business validation requirements, and support defect triage and sign\-off activities.
* Track project milestones, risks, dependencies, deliverables, and timelines to ensure successful and high\-quality implementation of business solutions.


**What You’ll Need**
* Strong Business Analysis, Requirements Gathering, and Documentation skills.
* Experience in client\-facing support, stakeholder management, and relationship management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with US\-based clients.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Experience in incident management, issue resolution, escalation handling, and product support.
* Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical deliverables.
* Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and Release Management processes.
* Strong organizational, planning, multitasking, and project coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.


**Desired Skills**
* Experience in Life Insurance, Annuity, Retirement Services, or Financial Services domains.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, basic of XML and MS office.
* Ability to work in overlapping US business hours and support client engagements.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS environment supporting enterprise clients and product delivery.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
 At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning workloads.
* You'll own the day\-to\-day reliability of data ingestion processes, proactively troubleshooting pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data anomalies.
* You'll refactor and modernise existing ETL processes to improve efficiency, standardisation, and scalability.
* You'll reduce manual data movement through automation and the implementation of consistent engineering best practices.
* You'll support schema changes, incremental data loads, and the onboarding of new data sources and elements.
* You'll develop and optimise data models and data warehouse structures to ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability.
* You'll assist with database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and schema management activities.
* You'll deliver well\-structured, production\-ready datasets that enable analytics and data science teams to generate meaningful insights.
* You'll collaborate with engineering and analytics teams across multiple geographies to integrate data from diverse sources while ensuring consistent data quality standards.
* You'll write and optimise SQL queries to validate data completeness, accuracy, and integrity.
* You'll reconcile ETL outputs against source system reports, identifying and resolving data quality issues where required.
* You'll manage API\-based integrations, including handling pagination, rate limiting, and incremental data extraction processes.
* You'll work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders across time zones to understand business data requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* You'll actively participate in asynchronous workflows and virtual collaboration environments to maintain alignment across distributed teams.
* You'll communicate project progress, risks, blockers, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You'll implement monitoring, logging, and automation solutions to improve pipeline stability and minimise manual intervention.
* You'll create and maintain runbooks, ETL documentation, and process guides to support operational excellence and knowledge sharing.
* You'll follow and reinforce engineering standards covering naming conventions, development structures, and deployment practices.
* You'll support change management processes, version control, and controlled releases to ensure reliable and secure deployments.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* You'll have 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, ETL development, or a related technical role.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.
* You'll possess a solid understanding of ETL concepts, data integration principles, and data pipeline architecture.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) or a comparable ETL and data orchestration platform.
* You'll be experienced in working with REST APIs, including interpreting documentation, handling JSON payloads, and managing authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, and tokens.
* You'll have strong SQL and Python skills, including expertise in joins, aggregations, filtering, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation.
* You'll bring familiarity with cloud\-based data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
* You'll have experience using source code management and version control tools such as Git.
* You'll have knowledge of Vincilium or similar ETL tools.
* You'll bring exposure to Power BI datasets and backend reporting models that support business intelligence solutions.
* You'll have experience working with file\-based integrations, including CSV, Excel, and SFTP\-based data transfers.
* You'll demonstrate familiarity with insurance platforms and/or ERP and CRM systems.
* You'll be highly detail\-oriented, with a strong commitment to data accuracy, quality, and reliability.
* You'll be a proactive and self\-managing communicator who keeps remote stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned.
* You'll be comfortable working independently across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll be collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that successful data engineering outcomes are achieved through strong cross\-functional partnerships regardless of location.
* You'll be eager to learn, grow, and take on increasing levels of ownership as the platform and team continue to evolve.
* You'll have the opportunity to progress into more senior data engineering or platform architecture roles, taking greater ownership of ingestion architecture, driving standardisation across new data sources, and contributing to the growth and maturity of the wider data platform.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

We collaborate closely with portfolio managers, research analysts, and technology experts to deliver actionable insights that support investment decision\-making. Joining us means working in a dynamic, intellectually stimulating environment where you will contribute to data\-driven investment decisions while growing your expertise in finance and emerging technologies.

**What You’ll Get** 



* Real ownership of ML systems that go into production for serious clients.

 The QA Engineer role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation\-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each QA Engineer will be part of a geo\-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
   

  

 We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented
 **Associate Quality Engineer** 
 to join our Quality Engineering team. This role is ideal for early‑career professionals who have a strong foundation in SDLC, functional testing, automation basics, and a keen desire to grow into a full\-stack Quality Engineer. You will work closely with QA, development, and product teams to deliver high‑quality software through structured testing and automation practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Assurance \& Testing**
* Participate in reviewing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios.
* Design, create, and execute manual and automated test cases for web applications.
* Perform functional, regression, and smoke testing with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Understand and follow established QA processes, defect lifecycle, and Agile development methodologies (Scrum preferred).


**Automation**
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright (TypeScript preferred / JavaScript acceptable).
* Apply modular and scalable automation design principles (DRY, POM, componentization).
* Contribute to expanding automation coverage across UI and API layers.
* Help identify tests suitable for automation and maintain test suites for reliability and performance.


**API \& Performance Testing (Value Add \- Strong Preference)**
* Execute and validate API tests using tools like Postman, Bruno, or similar.
* Exposure to performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) is preferred.


**Collaboration \& Reporting**
* Log defects with clear reproduction steps and detailed insights using JIRA or similar tools.
* Collaborate with developers, product owners, and senior QA resources to ensure timely resolution of defects.
* Participate in daily standups, sprint ceremonies, and QA planning discussions.
* Maintain test documentation, automation scripts, and version\-controlled repositories using Git.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and QA methodologies.
* Hands‑on experience with Playwright automation using TypeScript (preferred)/JavaScript(acceptable).
* Basic knowledge of API testing and performance testing concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving abilities.
* Ability to quickly learn tools, frameworks, and new technologies.
* Effective communication skills (written \& verbal).
* Detail‑oriented, organized, and committed to delivering high‑quality work.
* Collaborative mindset with willingness to take guidance and grow.
* Familiarity with using AI‑assisted tools for productivity (optional but beneficial).


**Qualifications**
**Must Have:**
* 3\-5 years of experience in software testing or quality engineering.
* Practical experience with Playwright (TypeScript or JavaScript).
* Understanding of Agile processes, QA fundamentals, and defect lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Git or other version control systems.
* Experience with JIRA or any task/defect tracking tool.
* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM
* Experience with Agile Scrum and ATDD methodologies.


**Good to Have:**
* Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, Bruno, etc.).
* Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling).
* Experience automating mobile platforms, a plus.
* Experience in writing SQL queries and database automation.
* Experience in scripting languages, such as Python or Ruby, are a plus.


**What We Look For**
 We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you.
   

  

**What Working At ACA Offers**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
   

  

  

  

**Plus, we offer:**
* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**Why join our team?**
 We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
   

  

 Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award\-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
   

  

**More About ACA**
 ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
   

  

 Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
   

  

**What We Commit To**
 ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
   

  

 ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
   

  

 Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

description:
**Company Description**
 Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
   

  

 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
   

  

 Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

 Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
   

  

**About Vialto Labs (VLabs)**
 Vialto Labs (VLabs) is responsible for redesigning how work is delivered in the tax and immigration service lines, as well as driving operational efficiency across Vialto’s functional areas using AI. The team builds and deploys novel AI\-enabled solutions that directly improve productivity and increase delivery quality for our clients. VLabs is accountable for rapidly turning innovative experiments into production\-ready deliverables at scale and embedding them into day\-to\-day operations. This team focuses on the highest\-impact workflows, creating standardized, repeatable capabilities that can be deployed globally. Operating with a mandate for speed and measurable outcomes, VLabs works alongside service line, product, and platform leaders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Performance Test Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and executing performance testing strategies for AI\-enabled platforms and integrated enterprise workflows. This is a hands\-on role that owns the full non\-functional testing lifecycle, from load model design through execution and reporting. The role ensures systems meet defined performance thresholds, scalability requirements, and production readiness standards.
   

  

 Given the presence of AI components such as OCR, vision language models, and LLM inference, this role requires designing performance models that account for variability in response times and non\-deterministic behavior. The role works closely with AI Test Engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure performance risks are identified early and addressed prior to release.
   

  

 Success is defined by the ability to produce actionable insights, support release gating decisions, and ensure systems can scale reliably under real\-world conditions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Performance Test Strategy \& Design**
* Own the end\-to\-end performance testing lifecycle, from test strategy through execution and reporting
* Design load models based on real usage patterns and program volume data rather than synthetic assumptions
* Define and validate non\-functional requirements including response times, throughput, concurrency, and system stability


**Load \& Stress Testing Execution**
* Build and execute JMeter\-based load and stress test scripts from scratch across API, UI, and integrated workflows
* Simulate concurrent sessions, transaction throughput, and end\-to\-end processing flows
* Configure and execute distributed testing where required in partnership with DevOps teams


**AI\-Aware Performance Modeling**
* Incorporate variability in AI component response times into performance models and test scenarios
* Define and validate timeout thresholds and acceptable performance ranges for AI endpoints
* Identify and isolate the impact of AI components on overall system performance and SLAs
* Monitor costs and token consumption plus related impact


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Validation**
* Test performance across multi\-step, AI\-integrated workflows including document processing, event pipelines, and trigger\-based systems
* Evaluate system behavior across upstream and downstream dependencies in distributed architectures
* Identify bottlenecks across services and clearly attribute root causes


**Reporting \& Release Readiness**
* Produce clear, concise performance reports including baseline metrics, SLA adherence, bottlenecks, and risk areas
* Translate technical findings into actionable insights for engineering, product, and business stakeholders
* Support release gating decisions by highlighting performance risks and mitigation strategies


**Automation \& Continuous Testing**
* Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines where feasible to support continuous validation
* Contribute to API contract testing using Postman/Newman as part of broader QE efforts
* Support ongoing performance regression monitoring across releases


**Standardization \& Scaling**
* Develop reusable performance testing frameworks and standardized load testing patterns
* Contribute to enterprise\-level performance testing standards and best practices across VLabs


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Log and manage non\-functional defects in ADO with clear reproducibility and impact analysis
* Ensure alignment with security, scalability, and reliability standards
* Support auditability and traceability of performance testing results tied to milestone sign\-offs


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Professional Experience**
* 4\+ years in performance testing, including experience leading non\-functional testing efforts within delivery programs
* Demonstrated experience working with AI\-enabled systems including GenAI, LLMs, or agentic workflows
* Experience with Locust, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog or Dynatrace
* Experience with Postman for API profiling and AWS Cloudwatch
* Proven track record building performance testing frameworks from scratch for complex, integrated systems
* Experience with distributed, event\-driven, or microservices\-based architecture
* Experience operating in sprint\-based, iterative delivery environments
* Background in regulated or compliance\-driven industries preferred


**Technical Expertise**
**JMeter**
* Advanced scripting including thread groups, samplers, timers, assertions, and distributed execution
* Analysis of throughput, error rates, and percentile response times with clear reporting outputs


**Postman / Newman**
* API contract testing and CI/CD integration for regression validation


**SQL / Python**
* Data validation under load, scripting for load modeling, and test data preparation


**Performance Monitoring Tools**
* Experience with tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar


**Additional Tools**
* Familiarity with k6, Gatling, or similar performance testing tools
* Use of Chrome DevTools / HAR files for script generation and traffic analysis
* Experience simulating authentication models such as OAuth2 or API key\-based sessions


**Operating Capabilities**
* Ability to operate independently and own performance testing outcomes end\-to\-end
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to diagnose complex system bottlenecks
* Ability to balance rigor with speed in fast\-paced delivery environments
* Strong communication skills to translate technical performance insights into business impact
* Collaborative approach working across engineering, AI, and DevOps teams


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field preferred


**Additional Information**
* This job is based in our Bangalore office with the possibility of hybrid work mode
* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note, AI is used as part of the application process

title: Associate Threat Response Analyst
description:
**Associate Threat Response Analyst – Threat Response Operations**
**About Mimecast**
 Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
   

  

 We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance \& Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
   

  

 Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**The driving force behind Security Response at Mimecast**
 As a Threat Response Analyst, you will be joining the Mimecast Threat Response Operations team and will be responsible for supporting on\-demand threat resolution for our customers. The service is designed to provide customers with prompt feedback and intelligence on email\-borne threats, remediate these threats from their email environment to reduce dwell time, and put the appropriate detections in place to prevent further incidents from occurring. The role may require working afternoon/evening shifts and being part of a rotation for holiday support.
   

  

 Threat Response team ensures that our security\-focused solutions are performing accurately and efficiently, thereby keeping our customers safe amidst a rapidly evolving threat landscape. Through threat research and customer feedback we identify where our security products can be improved for better detection of security threats.
   

  

 Threat Response works closely with research and development, as well as customer support. We are a global team that spans three continents.
   

  

**Why Join Our Team?**
*“If you’re interested in detecting and solving real\-world security problems, the Threat Response Operations team is for you. At Mimecast, we process over a billion emails and collaboration events each day. We use customer feedback, data from Threat Research and advancements in AI to keep our customers safe from threat actors, with speed and precision! With our focus on proactive, rather than reactive, approaches to threat detection,* 
*we play a key role in maintaining Mimecast’s exceptional reputation as a leading email and collaboration security provider.* 
 ” – Hiring Manager.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Analyze phishing/malicious email campaigns to identify IOCs
* Categorize email threats and determine the optimal methods to update detection
* Provide email security advice, expertise, and remediation to our customers
* Understand security policies within the Mimecast Administration Console and provide configuration suggestions to customers
* Research and investigate the latest security threats and their potential impact on Mimecast customers
* Work with security vendors on threat detection techniques and remediation
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience and understanding of email security technologies: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Strong understanding of SMTP, SSL/TLS, POP3, IMAP, TCP/IP
* Working knowledge of messaging (email traffic management) and routing
* Strong understanding of Domain Name System (DNS)
* Strong understanding of URL structure, including components like protocols, domains, subdomains, paths, and query parameters
* Experience working with email/malware detection and blocking techniques
* Experience working with threat intelligence platforms
* Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into customer\-friendly responses
* Curiosity about the infrastructure of phishing/malicious email campaigns
* Working within SaaS environments.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC)
* Experience with Mimecast products as an administrator.


**What We Bring**
 Join our Threat Reporting and Response team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting\-edge technologies and contributing to projects that have real customer impact. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements.
   

  

 Mimecast offers formal and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly \- working in cross\-functional teams to build your knowledge!
   

  

 We believe in ‘growth that’s good, we have ‘a culture that cares’ and we are on a ‘mission that matters’.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Model:** 
 We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:
   

  

* Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
* Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
* Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
* Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*
